component.name: herder
component.summary: Watch and steer coding agents across your machines

ul.li: The board: what every agent is doing, and the requests waiting on you
Answer an agent's approval or question as soon as it asks
Open a session to read its transcript, its tool calls and its pull requests, and send it the next prompt
Start a session in any project on any of your machines
Add a machine from the link another herder app shares, approved with your passkey

description.p: It shares its machines with the herder terminal UI on the same computer. The agents run on your machines, through each vendor's own command-line tool; the app never sees a provider login.
